platysma.definition: n either of two broad muscles located on either side of the neck and innervated by the facial nerve; extends from lower jaw to clavicle and is involved in moving the mouth and jaw

platysma phenomenon.translation: [医] [颈]阔肌现象(偏瘫患者张大口时,健侧颈阔肌强烈收缩)

platysmal reflex.translation: [医] [颈]阔肌瞳孔反射, 阔肌反射

platyspondylia.translation: 椎骨体扁平症, 扁椎骨

platystemon.translation: [网络] 宽丝罂粟属；平胸龟属
